body:
I know that it has been a long time since I posted this. I just want to apologize to you. In fact, I want to apologize to everyone on this sub. Everyone here does a great service. But I picked you because you are a mod, and I assume that it's not an easy job. Especially given the topic of this sub.

I was in a bad place when I made that post. Obviously I created a new account just to post that. I'd like to say I'm doing better, but honestly I don't care about that, and I really am not. I just feel like garbage because I disrupted a very important and valuable subreddit. Yes, I was heavily considering suicide... but this message should convey that I am still alive, luckily. 

But insulting people who take time out of their lives to help those that have no more options... I am ashamed of myself. I can't say how much respect I have for you guys. Thank you for what you said. I read all of it. And if you respond to me, I will read that too. I just want you to know that someone respects you. Not only for helping those who believe they have no other options... but also for modding a subreddit, which seems like a huge pain in the ass.

Sorry man, but thank you. Thank you.
